decisions.reason: The domain purchase already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the selected domain and registrar and removing the obsolete domain candidate.
Purchasing the warm-up domain does not change the policies for isolated test accounts, existing campaigns, or existing MeetAlfred leads.
The domain purchase does not change the MeetAlfred account setup or subscription plan.
The selected warm-up domain does not alter silent-lead recirculation, follow-up export, or campaign-cleanup behavior.
The domain purchase does not change the requirement to keep the existing MeetAlfred integration connected.
The warm-up domain selection does not affect which communication channels are visible in HubSpot lead records.
The domain purchase does not alter Apollo enrichment data or its automatic enrichment mode.
The purchased domain does not resume or otherwise change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
The domain purchase does not change the requirement to create and configure the Zapier account.
The warm-up domain decision does not resolve or change how existing CRM records are indicated to users.
The domain purchase does not resolve or change which LinkedIn-related URL is stored in the CRM.
